title: Why Dune Has NO Computers (Humanity Banned AI) #dune
description:
Ever wondered why Dune has no computers? In the story, humanity fought a nearly century-long war against thinking machines and banned them for about ten thousand years. Humans became the computers instead: the Mentats.

Dune: Part Three is due December 18, 2026.
